## Explanation
The predictive maintenance AI system forecasted machine failure due to excessive wear and tear, and reducing the wear-torque interaction by 10% and minimum tool wear by 10% could potentially prevent the failure by mitigating the causal factors contributing to the predicted failure.

## Actionable Recommendation
Operators should immediately monitor the tool wear levels and stop the machine if the minimum tool wear exceeds 0.85, as this threshold indicates a high risk of failure, allowing for proactive maintenance to prevent downtime and ensure safety.
